The Lakers defeated the Raptors, 131-125 tonight in Los Angeles. Luka Dončić finished with a team-high 45 points along with 15 rebounds and 8 three pointers for the Lakers, while Austin Reaves tallied 19 points, 4 assists and 3 rebounds in the game. Scottie Barnes recorded 29 points, 6 rebounds and 5 assists. The Lakers improve their record to 5-2 with the win, while the Raptors fall to 3-3 for the season.
